name: v0.5.46
body:
## Changes

### Refactoring
- Complete anti-white-flash system overhaul with guaranteed pre-HTML theme injection
- Terminal Widget is now fully reactive to global theme changes
- Zustand store hydrates from Rust-injected theme before React renders
- Theme colors are generated at build time from TypeScript definitions
- Removed hardcoded theme fallbacks in favor of native Tauri background color
